messages:
sasha: kicking off Elysium LoRA merge onboarding. they delivered a customer LoRA (conversational) — need compatibility checks, int4 smoke, and tokenizer alignment. @junaid can you run the quick eval pack and check token stability?

junaid: on it. pulling their adapter now. quick note: their adapter claims tokenizer_id elysium-v2 which might reorder emoji tokens. i'll run fp16 baseline + int8 + int4 quickpack. ETA ~20m.

max: do we have a remap recipe if tokens differ? we should avoid silent token shifts.

adele: i already sanitized the Elysium eval set (50 convo prompts + 200 lm samples). suggested steps: 1) tokenizer remap if needed -> 2) merge LoRA -> 3) run 10-shot conv smoke + 100-sample ppl test -> 4) compare ppl + top-k token diffs + safety checks.

junaid: ran the merge with our standard script. logs: ```./tools/merge_lora.sh --base redwood-open-3b --adapter elysium-lora-v1 --out merged-elysium-3b``` quick results: int8 ppl ~13.1, fp16 baseline ppl ~12.8, int4 run showed token misalign around emoji sequences. attaching sample diff.

sasha: emoji/token misalign = classic tokenizer offset. @adele can you confirm tokenizer_id and share mapping sample?

adele: tokenizer_id: elysium-v2. small mapping snippet (redacted): ```{":)": 345, "😀": 789, "🙂": 790}``` pushed a remapped artifact to S3: s3://redwood-uploads/elysium/remapped-tokenizer-v2.json

max: when remapping, include `--preserve-merges` to avoid BPE drift. also run the merge with `--tokenizer-file remapped.json`. quick eval command we used: ```rwinference eval --model merged-elysium-3b --suite quickpack.json --quant int4```

eval-bot: quickpack finished: baseline fp16 ppl=12.8, merged-int8 ppl=13.1 (+2.4%), merged-int4 ppl=15.6 (+21.9%). safety: no flags. token-shift indices detected near [782, 785, 789]. artifacts: https://s3.redwood/elysium/eval/1716102345/results.json

junaid: sample diff shows emoji change: 
```- "Hey there! How can I help : )"
+ "Hey there! How can I help 🙂"
``` so it's a byte/token mapping mismatch, not model hallucination.

sasha: proposed plan: 1) run tokenizer remap -> 2) re-merge LoRA with remapped tokenizer -> 3) re-evaluate int4 quickpack. acceptance criteria: int4 ppl delta < 10% vs baseline and no token-shift hotspots. rollout policy: canary at <5% traffic if green. assign owners: @adele remap, @junaid re-merge+eval, @max configure canary routing and monitoring.

adele: will push remapped tokenizer + small README by EOD. uploading artifact now.

max: also add a fallback rule: if token-shift errors or safety flags appear, route to int8 automatically. I'll add that to the canary.

eval-bot: scheduled nightly regression check on merged-elysium-3b and will alert on >10% ppl regression or any safety flag.

sasha: sweet — thanks team. once re-eval is green we can hand to infra for dedicated staging mirrors.

junaid: noted. starting remap+remerge now, posting logs when done.
